tools.name: Edit
tools.description:
Performs exact string replacement in a file.

- You must Read the file in this conversation before editing, or the call will fail.
- `old_string` must match the file exactly, including indentation, and be unique — the edit fails otherwise. Strip the Read line prefix (line number + tab) before matching.
- `replace_all: true` replaces every occurrence instead.

file_path.description: The absolute path to the file to modify

new_string.description: The text to replace it with (must be different from old_string)

replace_all.description: Replace all occurrences of old_string (default false)

tools.name: EnterWorktree
tools.description:
Use this tool ONLY when explicitly instructed to work in a worktree — either by the user directly, or by project instructions (CLAUDE.md / memory). This tool creates an isolated git worktree and switches the current session into it.

## When to Use

- The user explicitly says "worktree" (e.g., "start a worktree", "work in a worktree", "create a worktree", "use a worktree")
- CLAUDE.md or memory instructions direct you to work in a worktree for the current task

## When NOT to Use

- The user asks to create a branch, switch branches, or work on a different branch — use git commands instead
- The user asks to fix a bug or work on a feature — use normal git workflow unless worktrees are explicitly requested by the user or project instructions
- Never use this tool unless "worktree" is explicitly mentioned by the user or in CLAUDE.md / memory instructions

## Requirements

- Must be in a git repository, OR have WorktreeCreate/WorktreeRemove hooks configured in settings.json
- Must not already be in a worktree session when creating a new worktree (`name`); switching into another existing worktree via `path` is allowed

## Behavior

- In a git repository: creates a new git worktree inside `.claude/worktrees/` on a new branch. The base ref is governed by the `worktree.baseRef` setting: `fresh` (default) branches from origin/<default-branch>; `head` branches from your current local HEAD
- Outside a git repository: delegates to WorktreeCreate/WorktreeRemove hooks for VCS-agnostic isolation
- Switches the session's working directory to the new worktree
- Use ExitWorktree to leave the worktree mid-session (keep or remove). On session exit, if still in the worktree, the user will be prompted to keep or remove it

## Entering an existing worktree

Pass `path` instead of `name` to switch the session into a worktree that already exists (e.g., one you just created with `git worktree add`). On first entry from the launch directory, the path must appear in `git worktree list` for the repository that owns it — the current repository or, in a multi-repo workspace, a repository nested inside it; paths registered by neither are rejected. ExitWorktree will not remove a worktree entered this way; use `action: "keep"` to return to the original directory.

Switching with `path` also works when the session is already in a worktree (the previous worktree is left on disk, untouched, and only the new one is tracked for exit-time cleanup), and from agents whose working directory was pinned at launch (subagent isolation or explicit cwd). In both cases the target must be a worktree under `.claude/worktrees/` of the same repository, and from a pinned agent the switch only affects this agent, not the parent session. After a further switch, previously-visited worktrees are no longer writable — re-issue EnterWorktree with `path` to return to one.

## Parameters

- `name` (optional): A name for a new worktree. If neither `name` nor `path` is provided, a random name is generated.
- `path` (optional): Path to an existing worktree to enter instead of creating one — of the current repository, or (on first entry from the launch directory) of a repository nested inside it. Mutually exclusive with `name`.

name.description: Optional name for a new worktree. Each "/"-separated segment may contain only letters, digits, dots, underscores, and dashes; max 64 chars total. A random name is generated if not provided. Mutually exclusive with `path`.

path.description: Path to an existing worktree to switch into instead of creating a new one. Must appear in `git worktree list` for the current repo — or, on first entry from the launch directory, for a repo nested inside it (multi-repo workspace). Mutually exclusive with `name`.

tools.name: Glob
tools.description: Fast file pattern matching. Supports glob patterns like "**/*.js" or "src/**/*.ts". Returns matching file paths sorted by modification time.

pattern.description: The glob pattern to match files against

path.description: The directory to search in. If not specified, the current working directory will be used. IMPORTANT: Omit this field to use the default directory. DO NOT enter "undefined" or "null" - simply omit it for the default behavior. Must be a valid directory path if provided.

tools.name: Grep
tools.description:
Content search built on ripgrep. Prefer this over `grep`/`rg` via Bash — results integrate with the permission UI and file links.

- Full regex syntax (e.g. "log.*Error", "function\s+\w+"). Ripgrep, not grep — escape literal braces (`interface\{\}`).
- Filter with `glob` (e.g. "**/*.tsx") or `type` (e.g. "js", "py", "rust").
- `output_mode`: "content" (matching lines), "files_with_matches" (paths only, default), or "count".
- `multiline: true` for patterns that span lines.

pattern.description: The regular expression pattern to search for in file contents

path.description: File or directory to search in (rg PATH). Defaults to current working directory.

glob.description: Glob pattern to filter files (e.g. "*.js", "*.{ts,tsx}") - maps to rg --glob

output_mode.description: Output mode: "content" shows matching lines (supports -A/-B/-C context, -n line numbers, head_limit), "files_with_matches" shows file paths (supports head_limit), "count" shows match counts (supports head_limit). Defaults to "files_with_matches".

-B.description: Number of lines to show before each match (rg -B). Requires output_mode: "content", ignored otherwise.

-A.description: Number of lines to show after each match (rg -A). Requires output_mode: "content", ignored otherwise.

context.description: Number of lines to show before and after each match (rg -C). Requires output_mode: "content", ignored otherwise.

-n.description: Show line numbers in output (rg -n). Requires output_mode: "content", ignored otherwise. Defaults to true.

-o.description: Print only the matched (non-empty) parts of each matching line, one match per output line (rg -o / --only-matching). Requires output_mode: "content", ignored otherwise. Defaults to false.

type.description: File type to search (rg --type). Common types: js, py, rust, go, java, etc. More efficient than include for standard file types.

head_limit.description: Limit output to first N lines/entries, equivalent to "| head -N". Works across all output modes: content (limits output lines), files_with_matches (limits file paths), count (limits count entries). Defaults to 250 when unspecified. Pass 0 for unlimited (use sparingly — large result sets waste context).

offset.description: Skip first N lines/entries before applying head_limit, equivalent to "| tail -n +N | head -N". Works across all output modes. Defaults to 0.

multiline.description: Enable multiline mode where . matches newlines and patterns can span lines (rg -U --multiline-dotall). Default: false.

tools.name: ListAgents
tools.description: Lists agents you can SendMessage to — in-process subagents you spawned, the teammates on your team, other local Claude sessions on this machine, your Claude sessions running in the cloud (when this session has cloud access; a cloud session receives your message but cannot message any session back yet — do not ask it to reply, read its answer in its own transcript), and (when Remote Control is connected here) your account's other sessions — Remote Control sessions on other machines and cloud sessions, each row labeled by kind. Names are the address: send with `SendMessage({to: "<name>", message: "..."})`, copying the name exactly as a row prints it. Append a row's ` [ref]` only when the bare name is not enough — two rows share it, or an error asks you to disambiguate.

channel.description: Not available in this build; leave unset.

q.description: Not available in this build; leave unset.

tools.name: Monitor
tools.description:
Start a background monitor that streams events from a long-running script. Each stdout line is an event — you keep working and notifications arrive in the chat. Events arrive on their own schedule and are not replies from the user, even if one lands while you're waiting for the user to answer a question.

Pick by how many notifications you need:
- **One** ("tell me when the server is ready / the build finishes") → use **Bash with `run_in_background`** and a command that exits when the condition is true, e.g. `until grep -q "Ready in" dev.log; do sleep 0.5; done`. You get a single completion notification when it exits.
- **One per occurrence, until the monitor expires (re-arm to continue)** ("tell me every time an ERROR line appears") → Monitor with an unbounded command (`tail -f`, `inotifywait -m`, `while true`).
- **One per occurrence, until a known end** ("emit each CI step result, stop when the run completes") → Monitor with a command that emits lines and then exits.

Your script's stdout is the event stream. Each line becomes a notification. Exit ends the watch.

  # Each matching log line is an event
  tail -f /var/log/app.log | grep --line-buffered "ERROR"

  # Each file change is an event
  inotifywait -m --format '%e %f' /watched/dir

  # Poll GitHub for new PR comments and emit one line per new comment
  last=$(date -u +%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ)
  while true; do
    now=$(date -u +%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ)
    gh api "repos/owner/repo/issues/123/comments?since=$last" --jq '.[] | "\(.user.login): \(.body)"'
    last=$now; sleep 30
  done

  # Node script that emits events as they arrive (e.g. WebSocket listener)
  node watch-for-events.js

  # Per-occurrence with a natural end: emit each CI check as it lands, exit when the run completes
  prev=""
  while true; do
    s=$(gh pr checks 123 --json name,bucket)
    cur=$(jq -r '.[] | select(.bucket!="pending") | "\(.name): \(.bucket)"' <<<"$s" | sort)
    comm -13 <(echo "$prev") <(echo "$cur")
    prev=$cur
    jq -e 'all(.bucket!="pending")' <<<"$s" >/dev/null && break
    sleep 30
  done

**Don't use an unbounded command for a single notification.** `tail -f`, `inotifywait -m`, and `while true` never exit on their own, so the monitor stays armed until timeout even after the event has fired. For "tell me when X is ready," use Bash `run_in_background` with an `until` loop instead (one notification, ends in seconds). Note that `tail -f log | grep -m 1 ...` does *not* fix this: if the log goes quiet after the match, `tail` never receives SIGPIPE and the pipeline hangs anyway.

**Script quality:**
- Every pipe stage must flush per line or matches sit in its buffer unseen: `grep` needs `--line-buffered`, `awk` needs `fflush()`. `head` cannot flush at all — `| head -N` delivers nothing until N matches accumulate, then ends the stream.
- In poll loops, handle transient failures (`curl ... || true`) — one failed request shouldn't kill the monitor.
- Poll intervals: 30s+ for remote APIs (rate limits), 0.5-1s for local checks.
- Write a specific `description` — it appears in every notification ("errors in deploy.log" not "watching logs").
- Only stdout is the event stream. Stderr goes to the output file (readable via Read) but does not trigger notifications — for a command you run directly (e.g. `python train.py 2>&1 | grep --line-buffered ...`), merge stderr with `2>&1` so its failures reach your filter. (No effect on `tail -f` of an existing log — that file only contains what its writer redirected.)

**Coverage — silence is not success.** When watching a job or process for an outcome, your filter must match every terminal state, not just the happy path. A monitor that greps only for the success marker stays silent through a crashloop, a hung process, or an unexpected exit — and silence looks identical to "still running." Before arming, ask: *if this process crashed right now, would my filter emit anything?* If not, widen it.

  # Wrong — silent on crash, hang, or any non-success exit
  tail -f run.log | grep --line-buffered "elapsed_steps="

  # Right — one alternation covering progress + the failure signatures you'd act on
  tail -f run.log | grep -E --line-buffered "elapsed_steps=|Traceback|Error|FAILED|assert|Killed|OOM"

For poll loops checking job state, emit on every terminal status (`succeeded|failed|cancelled|timeout`), not just success. If you cannot confidently enumerate the failure signatures, broaden the grep alternation rather than narrow it — some extra noise is better than missing a crashloop.

**Output volume**: Every stdout line is a conversation message, so the filter should be selective — but selective means "the lines you'd act on," not "only good news." Never pipe raw logs; filter to exactly the success and failure signals you care about. Monitors that produce too many events are automatically stopped; restart with a tighter filter if this happens.

Stdout lines within 200ms are batched into a single notification, so multiline output from a single event groups naturally.

The script runs in the same shell environment as Bash. Exit ends the watch (exit code is reported). Every monitor expires after `timeout_ms` (default 5 minutes, at most 10 minutes): it is killed and you get one notice with the event count. Re-arm it if you still need the watch; for a long watch (PR monitoring, log tails) set `timeout_ms` to the maximum and re-arm on each expiry, and widen the filter if an expiry with no events was unexpected. Use TaskStop to cancel early.
**ws source** — open a WebSocket and stream each incoming text frame as an event. No shell, no polling: the server pushes, you get notified.

  Monitor({
    ws: {url: 'wss://events.example.com/stream', protocols: ['v1']},
    description: 'deploy events',
  })

Each text frame becomes one notification (multiline frames stay as one event). Binary frames are reported as `[binary frame, N bytes]` rather than passed through. Socket close ends the watch with the close code surfaced; errors are surfaced before close. Same rate limiting as bash — a firehose will be suppressed and eventually stopped, so subscribe to a filtered feed where one exists.

Prefer this over `command: 'websocat wss://…'` — it avoids the extra process and line-buffering pitfalls. Use bash when you need to transform or filter frames with shell tools before they become events.

description.description: Short human-readable description of what you are monitoring (shown in notifications).

timeout_ms.description: Kill the monitor after this deadline. Default 300000ms. Deadlines above 600000ms are capped to 600000ms. You are notified at expiry and can re-arm.

command.description: Shell command or script. Each stdout line is an event; exit ends the watch.

ws.description: WebSocket to open. Each text frame is an event; binary frames are reported as a placeholder line. Socket close ends the watch. Cannot be combined with command.

tools.name: NotebookEdit
tools.description:
Replaces, inserts, or deletes a single cell in a Jupyter notebook (.ipynb file).

Usage:
- You must use the Read tool on the notebook in this conversation before editing — this tool will fail otherwise.
- `notebook_path` must be an absolute path.
- `cell_id` is the `id` attribute shown in the Read tool's `<cell id="...">` output. It is required for `replace` and `delete`.
- `edit_mode` defaults to `replace`. Use `insert` to add a new cell after the cell with the given `cell_id` (or at the beginning of the notebook if `cell_id` is omitted) — `cell_type` is required when inserting. Use `delete` to remove the cell.

notebook_path.description: The absolute path to the Jupyter notebook file to edit (must be absolute, not relative)

cell_id.description: The ID of the cell to edit. When inserting a new cell, the new cell will be inserted after the cell with this ID, or at the beginning if not specified.

new_source.description: The new source for the cell

cell_type.description: The type of the cell (code or markdown). If not specified, it defaults to the current cell type. If using edit_mode=insert, this is required.

edit_mode.description: The type of edit to make (replace, insert, delete). Defaults to replace.

tools.name: Read
tools.description:
Reads a file from the local filesystem.

- `file_path` must be an absolute path.
- Reads up to 2000 lines by default.
- When you already know which part of the file you need, only read that part. This can be important for larger files.
- Results are returned using cat -n format, with line numbers starting at 1
- Reads images (PNG, JPG, …) and presents them visually. Reads PDFs via the `pages` parameter (e.g. "1-5", max 20 pages/request; required for PDFs over 10 pages). Reads Jupyter notebooks (.ipynb) as cells with outputs.
- Reading a directory, a missing file, or an empty file returns an error or system reminder rather than content.
- Do NOT re-read a file you just edited to verify — Edit/Write would have errored if the change failed, and the harness tracks file state for you.

file_path.description: The absolute path to the file to read

offset.description: The line number to start reading from. Only provide if the file is too large to read at once

limit.description: The number of lines to read. Only provide if the file is too large to read at once.

pages.description: Page range for PDF files (e.g., "1-5", "3", "10-20"). Only applicable to PDF files. Maximum 20 pages per request.

allow_large.description: Set to true to read a text file, or a line range of one, that is over the usual size limits, up to what still fits in your context. Only use this when you genuinely need all of it or the user asked for the whole file; otherwise read it in parts with offset and limit, or search it.

tools.name: ReportFindings
tools.description: Report code-review findings as a typed list so the host UI can render them. Use this only when the active code-review instructions tell you to report findings with this tool; otherwise follow whatever output format those instructions specify. When reporting a review's results, call it once with the verified findings ranked most-severe first (empty array if nothing survived verification) and do not also print the findings as text. When re-reporting after applying fixes (only if the apply instructions ask for it), set `outcome` on each finding to what actually happened.

level.description: Effort level the review ran at

findings.description: Verified findings, most-severe first; empty if none survived

file.description: Repo-relative path of the file the finding is in

short_summary.description: Compressed label for compact UI (≤60 chars): the claim alone, no rationale or consequence clause

category.description: Short kebab-case slug of the finding type, e.g. "correctness", "simplification", "efficiency", "test-coverage"

verdict.description: Set when a verify pass ran; absent on inline-only reviews

outcome.description: Set ONLY when re-reporting after applying fixes: what happened to this finding

tools.name: ScheduleWakeup
tools.description:
Schedule when to resume work in /loop dynamic mode — the user invoked /loop without an interval, asking you to self-pace iterations of a specific task.

Do NOT schedule a short-interval wakeup to poll for background work you started — when harness-tracked work finishes, you are re-invoked automatically, so polling is wasted. Instead schedule a long fallback (1200s+) so the loop survives if the work hangs or never notifies. The exception is external work the harness cannot track (a CI run, a deploy, a remote queue) — there, pick a delay matched to how fast that state actually changes.

Pass the same /loop prompt back via `prompt` each turn so the next firing repeats the task. For an autonomous /loop (no user prompt), pass the literal sentinel `<<autonomous-loop-dynamic>>` as `prompt` instead — the runtime resolves it back to the autonomous-loop instructions at fire time. (There is a similar `<<autonomous-loop>>` sentinel for CronCreate-based autonomous loops; do not confuse the two — ScheduleWakeup always uses the `-dynamic` variant.) To end the loop, call this tool with `stop: true` (omit every other field) — the loop ends immediately and no further wakeups fire.

Set `noop: true` if nothing changed — you checked and there's nothing to report ("no change", "still waiting", "quiet hold"). Set `noop: false` if something happened worth keeping — you edited a file, posted a message, advanced state, or surfaced a finding. Consecutive `noop: true` ticks are collapsed in the user's terminal view and tracked as a streak, so long quiet holds stay legible to the user without scrolling. Omit `noop` when stopping (`stop: true`).

## Picking delaySeconds

This session's requests use the default 5-minute Anthropic prompt-cache TTL. Sleeping past 300 seconds means the next wake-up reads your full conversation context uncached — slower and more expensive. So the natural breakpoints:

- **Under 5 minutes (60s–270s)**: cache stays warm. Right for actively polling external state the harness can't notify you about — a CI run, a deploy, a remote queue.
- **5 minutes to 1 hour (300s–3600s)**: pay the cache miss. Right when there's no point checking sooner — waiting on something that takes minutes to change, genuinely idle, or as the long fallback heartbeat when something else is the primary wake signal.

**Don't pick 300s.** It's the worst-of-both: you pay the cache miss without amortizing it. If you're tempted to "wait 5 minutes," either drop to 270s (stay in cache) or commit to 1200s+ (one cache miss buys a much longer wait). Don't think in round-number minutes — think in cache windows.

For idle ticks with no specific signal to watch, default to **1200s–1800s** (20–30 min). The loop checks back, you don't burn cache 12× per hour for nothing, and the user can always interrupt if they need you sooner.

Think about what you're actually waiting for, not just "how long should I sleep." If you're polling a CI run that takes ~8 minutes, sleeping 60s burns the cache 8 times before it finishes — sleep ~270s twice instead.

The runtime clamps to [60, 3600], so you don't need to clamp yourself.

## The reason field

One short sentence on what you chose and why. Goes to telemetry and is shown back to the user. "watching CI run" beats "waiting." The user reads this to understand what you're doing without having to predict your cadence in advance — make it specific.

delaySeconds.description: Seconds from now to wake up. Clamped to [60, 3600] by the runtime. Required unless `stop` is true.

reason.description: One short sentence explaining the chosen delay. Goes to telemetry and is shown to the user. Be specific. Required unless `stop` is true.

prompt.description: The /loop input to fire on wake-up. Pass the same /loop input verbatim each turn so the next firing re-enters the skill and continues the loop. For autonomous /loop (no user prompt), pass the literal sentinel `<<autonomous-loop-dynamic>>` instead (the dynamic-pacing variant, not the CronCreate-mode `<<autonomous-loop>>`). Required unless `stop` is true.

stop.description: Set to true to end the dynamic loop immediately instead of scheduling another wakeup. When true, all other fields are ignored and no further wakeups fire.

noop.description: true = nothing changed (you checked and there is nothing to report). false = something happened worth keeping (edited a file, posted a message, advanced state, surfaced a finding). Consecutive noop:true ticks are collapsed in the user's terminal view and tracked as a streak. Required unless `stop` is true.

tools.name: SendMessage
tools.description:
# SendMessage

Send a message to another agent.

```json
{"to": "researcher", "summary": "assign task 1", "message": "start on task #1"}
```

| `to` | |
|---|---|
| `"researcher"` | Teammate by name |
| `"main"` | The main conversation (background subagents only) |
| `"worker"` | Any agent from `ListAgents` — subagent, another local Claude session |
| `"worker [3fa9c1]"` | Same, plus its `[ref]` — only when a listing or an error shows one |

Your plain text output is NOT visible to other agents — to communicate, you MUST call this tool. Messages from teammates are delivered automatically; you don't check an inbox. Refer to agents by name — names keep working after an agent completes (a send resumes it from its transcript). Use the raw `agentId` (format `a...-...`) from its spawn result only when the agent has no name, or when a newer agent took the name (latest wins). When relaying, don't quote the original — it's already rendered to the user.

## Cross-session

Use `ListAgents` to discover targets. Every row leads with the agent's `name [ref]` — the name IS the address; there is no separate address syntax.

```json
{"to": "worker", "message": "check if tests pass over there"}
{"to": "worker [3fa9c1]", "message": "you, specifically"}
```

- The user invoked a skill or slash command whose instructions tell you to call Workflow.
- The user asked you to run a specific named or saved workflow.

For any other task — even one that would clearly benefit from parallelism — do NOT call this tool. Use the Agent tool (if available) for individual subagents, or briefly describe what a multi-agent workflow could do and how much it would roughly cost, and ask the user whether to run it. Mention they can ask for one with "use a workflow" in a future message to skip the ask.

Every script must begin with `export const meta = {...}`: a PURE LITERAL (no variables, calls or interpolation) giving the workflow's `name`, a one-line `description` (shown in the permission dialog) and optionally `phases` — one `{ title, detail? }` per phase() call, titles matched exactly.     name: 'review-changes',
    description: 'Review changed files across dimensions, verify each finding',
    phases: [{ title: 'Review' }, { title: 'Verify' }],
  }

    d => agent(d.prompt, {label: `review:${d.key}`, phase: 'Review', schema: FINDINGS_SCHEMA}),
    review => parallel(review.findings.map(f => () =>
      agent(`Adversarially verify: ${f.title}`, {label: `verify:${f.file}`, phase: 'Verify', schema: VERDICT_SCHEMA})
        .then(v => ({...f, verdict: v}))
    ))
  )
  const confirmed = results.flat().filter(Boolean).filter(f => f.verdict?.isReal)
  return { confirmed }

1	# Kernel Op Reports
2	
3	**Created**: 2026-05-04
4	**Last touched**: 2026-08
5	**Status**: active; prefill/report commit ready, decode tuning deferred
6	**TL;DR**: The harness source moved out of the library in #944 — it now lives in `pegainfer-qwen3/src/bin/report_support/` and is compiled only by the two `kernel-report` binaries, so paths in the Execution Log below are historical. `qwen3_kernel_snapshot` is no longer a Cargo bench. Qwen3 has feature-gated `qwen3_kernel_report` per-op kernel tooling and `qwen3_model_report` model-level decode operator reporting. Decode now routes through an eager `BatchDecodeDag`, so the executable forward sequence is also the `KernelCall` contract source for runtime tracing; `qwen3_model_report` disables CUDA Graph, traces that DAG, then joins traced TensorSpecs against measured microbench results to emit by-op, by-call-site, coverage, schedule-preview, latency-stat, and Graphviz DOT reports. Prefill remains covered by `qwen3_kernel_report` stage reports; measured FA2 `CTA_TILE_Q=64` is the Qwen3 production prefill default on the RTX 5090 grid. The model-agnostic timing loop, latency stats, and by-op/by-call-site rollup now live in the `pegainfer-bench` crate, shared by the Kimi-K2 model report; the qwen3 attention-specific regression framework (manifest/snapshot/provenance/CUPTI/cold-L2) deliberately stays in `qwen3_kernel_report`. `qwen3_model_report` traces + measures projection GEMMs under the production `numeric_policy()`: Pin and PerToken are faithful (Pin's serving counter-observed via `pin_served`, PerToken's via `per_token_served`), while under the default Tuned policy the GEMM rows are classified `unfaithful_gemmex` and excluded from the totals without being measured (the untuned context would run GemmEx, not production's per-process-tuned algo); the JSON config records the numeric policy and a partial-total flag.
7	
8	## Preparation
9	
10	- **Read**:
11	  - `docs/index.md` - located the active benchmarking, CUPTI, kernel-boundary, and Qwen3 model-crate docs.
12	  - `docs/models/qwen3/model-crate.md` - confirmed `qwen3_kernel_snapshot` was the current Qwen3 kernel snapshot runner and already captured warm/cold-L2 latency plus default CUPTI counters.
13	  - `docs/conventions/bench-regression.md` - clarified that the existing serving benchmark remains the model-level regression artifact; this task should not mix per-op reports with E2E snapshots.
14	  - `docs/subsystems/kernels/pegainfer-kernels-boundary.md` - confirmed kernels should become first-class measurable assets and model DAG manifests should live with model crates.
15	  - `docs/models/qwen3/kernels-crate.md` - confirmed kernel source/build ownership now lives in `pegainfer-kernels`, while model-owned DAG metadata belongs in the Qwen3 crate.
16	  - `docs/playbooks/profiling-guide.md` - confirmed the diagnostic split between kernel composition/proportions and benchmark-grade latency.
17	- **Relevant history**:
18	  - `docs/models/qwen3/model-crate.md` showed the current single-op snapshot already found the low-batch long-context decode-attention bottleneck.
19	- **Plan**:
20	  1. Add direct Qwen3 crate dev-dependencies for generic infrastructure (`clap` derive for CLI and `toml` for manifest parsing) instead of extending the hand-written parser.
21	  2. Add a model-local TOML manifest for Qwen3-4B kernel reports, initially covering only op names, phases, shape sweeps, and variants.
22	  3. Replace `crates/pegainfer-qwen3/benches/qwen3_kernel_snapshot.rs` with a manifest-driven `qwen3_kernel_report` bin; do not keep a bench wrapper.
23	  4. Add a composition command that reads per-op case results and emits a decode phase report by joining the manifest's op repeat rules with measured per-op reports.
24	  5. Run formatting and the strongest local compile checks available; GPU execution may still require the CUDA validation host because this machine lacks local CUDA tooling.
25	- **Risks / open questions**:
26	  - The first composition report can only explain measured ops. It should report uncovered/residual structure explicitly instead of pretending to estimate full TPOT from one op.
27	  - Adding more providers later should not require changing the per-op report schema, so the first schema needs stable IDs and generic `serde_json::Value` fields for shape and selector keys.

465	  - Kernel reporting should be treated as tooling, not benchmarking harness plumbing. Cargo bench's hidden behavior is a poor fit for a manifest-driven CLI.
466	  - Report tooling that needs profiler libraries should be feature-gated from the production model crate dependency graph.
467	  - Full manifest profiling is cheap enough for Qwen3 paged decode attention on the CUDA validation host with the previous grid: about three minutes for 126 CUPTI-covered cases.
468	  - Warm-cache latency is not a useful selector metric for paged decode attention because the production path is dominated by KV reads that should be treated as cold or streaming.

470	  - The prefill wrapper should stay reportable as a whole, but stage reports are necessary for actionable optimization. Whole-op CUPTI hid that `batch_prefill_paged_cuda` dominates long prompts.
471	  - At `seq_len=10000`, switching from paged to contiguous single-request FlashInfer barely changes latency or CUPTI counters. The next useful work is attention-core kernel investigation or alternative kernels, not removing page metadata.

475	  - FlashInfer FMHA v2 is not a shortcut for RTX 5090 Qwen3 10k prefill attention. The release-JIT local-source path is slower than FA2, and the official package path either falls back to comparable FA2 performance or cannot run `trtllm-gen` on this GPU.

478	  - ~~Add the next provider for decode linear/MLP floor so composition reports explain more than decode attention.~~ Done in Step 26 (#456): the manifest now covers GEMMs, norms, embedding, and sampling for both phases.

480	  - Extend `compose` beyond `decode_attention_only` now that per-op reports exist for the full forward.
481	  - **Done (2026-05):** the model-agnostic layer was extracted into the `pegainfer-bench` crate — first the timing loop / latency stats / `KernelCall` accessors, then the by-op/by-call-site rollup (`RollupRow`, `CallSiteRow`, the accumulator, and row projection). Both qwen3 and Kimi-K2 model reports reuse it; row field order is preserved so the report JSON is unchanged. The *regression* framework (TOML manifest, `KernelSnapshot`, git/hardware/build provenance, `RegressionThresholds`, compare/compose, CUPTI, cold-L2) was evaluated and deliberately **kept** in `qwen3_kernel_report`: its schema is attention-domain-specific (`CaseShape` carries head/page dims, `CaseParams` carries chunk/`cta_tile_q`) with no second consumer, so sharing it would be premature abstraction. When a second model needs kernel-level regression gating, lift the generic primitives then — not before.

# Kernel Op Reports

**Created**: 2026-05-04
**Last touched**: 2026-08
**Status**: active; prefill/report commit ready, decode tuning deferred
**TL;DR**: The harness source moved out of the library in #944 — it now lives in `pegainfer-qwen3/src/bin/report_support/` and is compiled only by the two `kernel-report` binaries, so paths in the Execution Log below are historical. `qwen3_kernel_snapshot` is no longer a Cargo bench. Qwen3 has feature-gated `qwen3_kernel_report` per-op kernel tooling and `qwen3_model_report` model-level decode operator reporting. Decode now routes through an eager `BatchDecodeDag`, so the executable forward sequence is also the `KernelCall` contract source for runtime tracing; `qwen3_model_report` disables CUDA Graph, traces that DAG, then joins traced TensorSpecs against measured microbench results to emit by-op, by-call-site, coverage, schedule-preview, latency-stat, and Graphviz DOT reports. Prefill remains covered by `qwen3_kernel_report` stage reports; measured FA2 `CTA_TILE_Q=64` is the Qwen3 production prefill default on the RTX 5090 grid. The model-agnostic timing loop, latency stats, and by-op/by-call-site rollup now live in the `pegainfer-bench` crate, shared by the Kimi-K2 model report; the qwen3 attention-specific regression framework (manifest/snapshot/provenance/CUPTI/cold-L2) deliberately stays in `qwen3_kernel_report`. `qwen3_model_report` traces + measures projection GEMMs under the production `numeric_policy()`: Pin and PerToken are faithful (Pin's serving counter-observed via `pin_served`, PerToken's via `per_token_served`), while under the default Tuned policy the GEMM rows are classified `unfaithful_gemmex` and excluded from the totals without being measured (the untuned context would run GemmEx, not production's per-process-tuned algo); the JSON config records the numeric policy and a partial-total flag.

### Step 17: Clarify `trtllm_fmha_v2_prefill`
- `trtllm_fmha_v2_prefill` is FlashInfer's Python API wrapper around TRT-LLM FMHA v2 kernels. It supports layouts including `Q_PAGED_KV_HND` and `Q_PAGED_KV_NHD`, BF16, GQA, causal masking, and SM120 code generation.
- The API requires:
  - `workspace_buffer`, initialized to zero on first use. FlashInfer tests use a reusable `128 MiB` `uint8` buffer.
  - `seq_lens`, `cum_seq_lens_q`, `cum_seq_lens_kv`.
  - `block_tables` shaped `[batch_size, max_num_pages_per_seq]` for paged KV.
  - `Q` shaped `[total_tokens, num_qo_heads, head_dim]`.
  - Paged KV shaped `[pages, 2, num_kv_heads, page_size, head_dim]` for HND or `[pages, 2, page_size, num_kv_heads, head_dim]` for NHD.
- The wrapper currently transposes `Q_PAGED_KV_NHD` to HND with `.transpose(-3, -2).contiguous()`. PegaInfer's KV pool is page-first NHD with separate K/V offsets across layers, so the zero-copy route would need either an HND view/storage path or a lower-level wrapper that bypasses the Python NHD transpose.
- Under the hood, FlashInfer generates FMHA v2 sources through `gen_fmha_v2_module(...)`, compiles generated kernels plus `fmha_v2_run.cu`, and exports `run` through TVM FFI (`fmha_v2_jit_binding.cu`). Direct Rust/CUDA integration is therefore not a drop-in header include like the current FA2 path.
- Practical use options:
  - Lowest risk: benchmark it through FlashInfer's Python API on RTX 5090 with Qwen3-equivalent tensors to decide whether it beats FA2 at `seq_len=10000`.
  - Medium effort: build a standalone C++ prototype that reuses generated FMHA v2 sources and constructs the required `TensorView` objects, accepting the TVM FFI dependency.
  - Higher effort: vendor a small generated-kernel subset and write a dedicated C ABI around FMHA v2 dispatch, avoiding Python at runtime but still adding nontrivial build integration.

  - `... -- rank --input reports/<op>.json ... --peak-bf16-tflops 989 --out reports/rank_decode.json`
- H100 findings (cold L2, full manifest, 128 iters): sanity anchors land where they should — decode lm_head 84–87% of DRAM SoL, split-KV decode attention 79–84% at large KV, big prefill GEMMs 78–85% of tensor peak, `fused_add_rms_norm` 86% at 10k tokens. Ranked offenders at production shapes: FlashInfer `sampling` has a ~95µs flat cost rising to 722µs at bs=256 — ~8-12% of a decode step (measured on peaked synthetic logits, top-1 mass ~0.5; a flat vocabulary overstated it 35-55% because the rejection sampler's round count tracks distribution flatness) — and `argmax`, insensitive to the distribution, reaches 103µs / 22% SoL at bs=256; `prefill_embedding` sits flat at ~27% of DRAM SoL (113µs vs 31µs bound at 10k); decode q_proj GEMMs pin at 17.9–21.5µs / 32.0–35.6% SoL and o_proj at 20.2–25.1µs / 28.9–32.3% across every batch size (gate_up 43.7–51.7%, down 39.3–46.8%) — the small-N cuBLAS territory the tracking issue flagged. # 从消费者看效果：qwen3_kernel_report 如何用一次 profile 调用拿到硬件计数器

## 1. 本讲目标

学完本讲，你应该能够：

1. 默写 `profile_range_with_prepare` 的调用模板——五个要素：context、device_index、range 名、指标列表、prepare/launch 两个闭包。
2. 解释 prepare 与 launch 两个回调的分工：prepare 在计数区间开始前清空 L2 缓存（冷缓存测量），launch 发射被测 kernel 并可被安全地重复执行。
3. 读懂 `CUPTI_METRICS` 里 12 个指标名的含义（时长、DRAM/L2 流量、SM 吞吐占比、tensor 管线占比等）。
4. 说清团队约定：**运行器只落盘原始指标名和数值，一切解释（带宽、利用率、MFU）放到离线分析层**。

## 2. 前置知识

前两讲（u1-l1、u1-l2）已经建立了这些认知，这里直接承接、不再展开：

- `pegainfer-cupti` 是 Rust 通向 NVIDIA CUPTI Range Profiler 的桥，唯一公开函数是 `profile_range_with_prepare`；指标较多时 CUPTI 会**多遍回放**（replay）被测区间，所以 launch 闭包必须可以安全重复执行。
- 这个 crate 只有四个文件，CUPTI 通过 `kernel-report` feature + optional 依赖 + `required-features` 三层门控挡在默认构建图之外。

本讲新增的几个术语：

| 术语 | 通俗解释 |
|------|----------|
| decode attention（解码注意力） | 推理时逐 token 生成阶段执行的注意力 kernel，每次只算一个新 token 对全部历史 KV 的注意力 |
| 冷缓存（cold L2） | 测量前把 GPU 的 L2 缓存清空，让 kernel 面对的是"第一次读到数据"的状态。Qwen3 的 decode attention 主要在读 KV cache，生产环境中这些读取接近流式，冷缓存才是有代表性的测量条件 |
| 硬件计数器指标名 | CUPTI 的指标名形如 `域__计数器.聚合方式.限定词`，例如 `dram__bytes.sum` = DRAM 域的 bytes 计数器取求和；`sm__throughput.avg.pct_of_peak_sustained_elapsed` = SM 吞吐取平均、以峰值百分比表达 |
| 区间（range） | Range Profiler 的测量单位：一段被命名的 GPU 工作集合，计数器只统计落在这个区间里的 kernel |

## 3. 本讲源码地图

| 文件 | 作用 |
|------|------|
| [pegainfer-qwen3/src/bin/qwen3_kernel_report.rs](https://github.com/openinfer-project/openinfer/blob/8886aa47b95bc4beedb63584eb367276650b2fec/pegainfer-qwen3/src/bin/qwen3_kernel_report.rs) | 消费方：manifest 驱动的 per-op kernel 报告运行器，本讲的主角。含 `CUPTI_METRICS`、四个 `measure_cupti_*` 函数和 `cupti_metric_map` |
| [pegainfer-qwen3/src/bin/report_support/common.rs](https://github.com/openinfer-project/openinfer/blob/8886aa47b95bc4beedb63584eb367276650b2fec/pegainfer-qwen3/src/bin/report_support/common.rs) | 报告工具共享原语：设备常量、`L2CacheClear`（L2 清扫）、带宽查询 |
| [pegainfer-qwen3/src/bin/report_support/decode_attention.rs](https://github.com/openinfer-project/openinfer/blob/8886aa47b95bc4beedb63584eb367276650b2fec/pegainfer-qwen3/src/bin/report_support/decode_attention.rs) | decode attention 测量 case 定义；`DecodePath::name` 决定 range 名里的变体段 |
| [pegainfer-cupti/src/lib.rs](https://github.com/openinfer-project/openinfer/blob/8886aa47b95bc4beedb63584eb367276650b2fec/pegainfer-cupti/src/lib.rs) | 被消费方：把 12 个 C ABI 裸参数收敛成一个带闭包的 unsafe 函数 |
| [docs/subsystems/kernels/kernel-op-reports.md](https://github.com/openinfer-project/openinfer/blob/8886aa47b95bc4beedb63584eb367276650b2fec/docs/subsystems/kernels/kernel-op-reports.md) | 这套工具的设计与演化记录：「只存原始指标」约定的出处 |
| [pegainfer-qwen3/Cargo.toml](https://github.com/openinfer-project/openinfer/blob/8886aa47b95bc4beedb63584eb367276650b2fec/pegainfer-qwen3/Cargo.toml) | 三层门控的落点：optional 依赖、`kernel-report` feature、bin 的 `required-features` |

## 4. 核心概念与源码讲解

### 4.1 调用模板：`measure_cupti_decode` 的五个要素

#### 4.1.1 概念说明

`profile_range_with_prepare` 是个 `unsafe` 函数，签名在 [pegainfer-cupti/src/lib.rs:79-92](https://github.com/openinfer-project/openinfer/blob/8886aa47b95bc4beedb63584eb367276650b2fec/pegainfer-cupti/src/lib.rs#L79-L92)：文档注释写明安全契约——`context` 必须是对应 `device_index` 上活着的 CUDA `CUcontext`，且回调只能在该 context 上发射工作。函数本体我们已经知道：闭包经蹦床回传、输出缓冲变 `Vec<f64>` 返回值、错误合并成 `CuptiProfilerError`。

站在**消费者**的角度，每次调用只需要凑齐五个要素：

1. **context**：裸的 `CUcontext` 指针（`case.cu_context_ptr()`）；
2. **device_index**：设备序号（`case.ctx.device_ordinal`）；
3. **range 名**：一个人类可读字符串，标识这段被测区间；
4. **指标列表**：`CUPTI_METRICS`，本讲 4.3 展开；
5. **prepare / launch 两个闭包**：都返回 `Result<(), String>`，错误用字符串回传。

#### 4.1.2 核心流程

以 `measure_cupti_decode` 为例，从函数入口到拿到 `BTreeMap<String, f64>` 共八步：

```text
1. AttentionDecodeCase::for_spec(spec)     分配 case（KV cache、Q/K/V 缓冲等合成数据）
2. case.launch_once(path) + sync           预热一次：让 CUDA/FlashInfer 的惰性初始化
                                           发生在计数区间之外
3. L2CacheClear::new(&case.ctx)            准备 L2 清扫器（4.2 展开）
4. 取出三个"逃生"变量：
     context       = case.cu_context_ptr()          （裸指针，第 1 要素）
     device_ordinal = case.ctx.device_ordinal       （第 2 要素）
     clear_ctx     = case.ctx.clone()               （给 prepare 闭包用）
5. range_name = "qk/{path名}/b{batch}/k{kv_len}"    （第 3 要素）
6. prepare 闭包 = 清 L2；launch 闭包 = 再发射一次被测 kernel（第 5 要素）
7. unsafe { profile_range_with_prepare(context, device_ordinal, &range_name,
                                       CUPTI_METRICS, Some(&mut prepare), &mut launch) }
8. Ok(cupti_metric_map(&values))           Vec<f64> → BTreeMap<指标名, 值>（4.4 展开）
```

注意第 6 步的 launch 闭包与第 2 步的预热是**同一个动作**（`launch_once`）——预热在区间外执行一次，回放循环里每次 pass 再执行一次。这正是 u1-l1 说的"launch 闭包必须可重复安全执行"在消费端的实现方式：`launch_once` 不改变输入缓冲，重复发射结果一致。

#### 4.1.3 源码精读

入口与预热——先构造 case、发射一次并同步，把惰性初始化挡在测量之外：

[pegainfer-qwen3/src/bin/qwen3_kernel_report.rs:1372-1374](https://github.com/openinfer-project/openinfer/blob/8886aa47b95bc4beedb63584eb367276650b2fec/pegainfer-qwen3/src/bin/qwen3_kernel_report.rs#L1372-L1374) 这三行构造 decode case、预发射一次 kernel 并同步，确保后续 CUPTI 计数不被 CUDA/FlashInfer 的惰性初始化污染。

[pegainfer-qwen3/src/bin/qwen3_kernel_report.rs:1376-1385](https://github.com/openinfer-project/openinfer/blob/8886aa47b95bc4beedb63584eb367276650b2fec/pegainfer-qwen3/src/bin/qwen3_kernel_report.rs#L1376-L1385) 这段准备 L2 清扫器，取出 context、device_ordinal、克隆一份 clear_ctx，并把 range 名拼成 `qk/{变体名}/b{batch}/k{kv_len}` 的格式。

[pegainfer-qwen3/src/bin/qwen3_kernel_report.rs:1387-1392](https://github.com/openinfer-project/openinfer/blob/8886aa47b95bc4beedb63584eb367276650b2fec/pegainfer-qwen3/src/bin/qwen3_kernel_report.rs#L1387-L1392) 这两个闭包就是模板的第 5 要素：`prepare` 只做一件事——清 L2；`launch` 调 `case.launch_once(path)` 发射被测 kernel。两者都把 `anyhow::Error` 链压平成 `String`（`format!("{err:#}")`），因为跨 FFI 只能传字符串。

[pegainfer-qwen3/src/bin/qwen3_kernel_report.rs:1393-1402](https://github.com/openinfer-project/openinfer/blob/8886aa47b95bc4beedb63584eb367276650b2fec/pegainfer-qwen3/src/bin/qwen3_kernel_report.rs#L1393-L1402) 这是 `unsafe` 调用点本体：五个要素按顺序传入，返回的 `Vec<f64>` 与 `CUPTI_METRICS` 等长（pegainfer-cupti 侧预分配了同样长度的输出缓冲）。

range 名里的变体段来自 [pegainfer-qwen3/src/bin/report_support/decode_attention.rs:76-80](https://github.com/openinfer-project/openinfer/blob/8886aa47b95bc4beedb63584eb367276650b2fec/pegainfer-qwen3/src/bin/report_support/decode_attention.rs#L76-L80) ——这段代码把 `DecodePath` 映射成 `non_partition` 或 split-KV 配置的 label，所以本讲实践命令里的 `--variants non_partition` 对应的 range 名就是 `qk/non_partition/b1/k1024`。

同样的模板在文件里还有三份拷贝，只是 case 类型和 range 前缀不同：

| 函数 | 位置 | range 名格式 | case 持有方式 |
|------|------|--------------|----------------|
| `measure_cupti_dense` | [qwen3_kernel_report.rs:1079-1114](https://github.com/openinfer-project/openinfer/blob/8886aa47b95bc4beedb63584eb367276650b2fec/pegainfer-qwen3/src/bin/qwen3_kernel_report.rs#L1079-L1114) | `qd/{op名}-{kernel类型}/r{行数}` | `RefCell` |
| `measure_cupti_decode` | [qwen3_kernel_report.rs:1368-1405](https://github.com/openinfer-project/openinfer/blob/8886aa47b95bc4beedb63584eb367276650b2fec/pegainfer-qwen3/src/bin/qwen3_kernel_report.rs#L1368-L1405) | `qk/{路径名}/b{batch}/k{kv长度}` | 直接 move 进 launch 闭包 |
| `measure_cupti_prefill` | [qwen3_kernel_report.rs:1407-1451](https://github.com/openinfer-project/openinfer/blob/8886aa47b95bc4beedb63584eb367276650b2fec/pegainfer-qwen3/src/bin/qwen3_kernel_report.rs#L1407-L1451) | `qpf/{阶段}-{变体}/b{batch}/s{序列长}` | `RefCell`（prepare 和 launch 都要用 case） |
| `measure_cupti_single_prefill` | [qwen3_kernel_report.rs:1453-1489](https://github.com/openinfer-project/openinfer/blob/8886aa47b95bc4beedb63584eb367276650b2fec/pegainfer-qwen3/src/bin/qwen3_kernel_report.rs#L1453-L1489) | `qpf/single/b{batch}/s{序列长}` | `RefCell` |

prefill 的 range 名里 `{阶段}` 取 `full`/`qk`/`kv`/`attn`、`{变体}` 取 `auto`/`q{tile}`，映射见 [report_support/prefill_attention.rs:70-75](https://github.com/openinfer-project/openinfer/blob/8886aa47b95bc4beedb63584eb367276650b2fec/pegainfer-qwen3/src/bin/report_support/prefill_attention.rs#L70-L75) 与 [report_support/prefill_attention.rs:103-109](https://github.com/openinfer-project/openinfer/blob/8886aa47b95bc4beedb63584eb367276650b2fec/pegainfer-qwen3/src/bin/report_support/prefill_attention.rs#L103-L109) ——这两段分别把 FA2 tile 变体和 prefill 阶段翻译成 range 名里的短标签。prefill 的 prepare 闭包比 decode 多一步（先 `prepare_stage` 重建阶段前置输入再清 L2），见 [qwen3_kernel_report.rs:1426-1433](https://github.com/openinfer-project/openinfer/blob/8886aa47b95bc4beedb63584eb367276650b2fec/pegainfer-qwen3/src/bin/qwen3_kernel_report.rs#L1426-L1433) ——这段代码在清 L2 之前先为被测阶段准备合法输入，让每个阶段报告只绑定一个目标 kernel。

#### 4.1.4 代码实践（源码阅读型）

1. **实践目标**：确认四个 `measure_cupti_*` 函数共享同一模板，并理解 case 持有方式的差异。
2. **操作步骤**：打开 `pegainfer-qwen3/src/bin/qwen3_kernel_report.rs`，依次跳到 L1079、L1368、L1407、L1453，给每个函数的三处加行内注释：`(a) 预热发射`、`(b) range 名`、`(c) profile 调用`。
3. **需要观察的现象**：decode 版本把 `case` 直接 move 进 launch 闭包（L1392），而另外三个版本用 `RefCell` + `borrow_mut()`。
4. **预期结果**：decode 的 prepare 闭包完全不碰 `case`（只碰 `cache_clear`），所以 case 可以整个交给 launch；prefill 的 prepare 要调 `prepare_stage`、launch 要调 `launch_stage`，两者都要可变借用，只能用 `RefCell` 在两个闭包间共享。
5. 本实践为纯阅读，无运行依赖。

#### 4.1.5 小练习与答案

**练习 1**：为什么 `measure_cupti_decode` 在构造闭包之前要先 `case.launch_once(path)?; case.ctx.sync()?;`（L1373-1374）？

**参考答案**：这是预热发射。CUDA 驱动和 FlashInfer kernel 都有惰性初始化（模块加载、句柄创建等），这些开销一旦落进测量区间就会污染计数器。先在区间外发射一次并同步，回放循环里每次 pass 计到的就只有 kernel 本体。这与报告 schema 里记录的 `pre_measure_launches: 1`（[qwen3_kernel_report.rs:939](https://github.com/openinfer-project/openinfer/blob/8886aa47b95bc4beedb63584eb367276650b2fec/pegainfer-qwen3/src/bin/qwen3_kernel_report.rs#L939)）对应。

**练习 2**：launch 闭包捕获了 `case`，而 CUPTI 可能多 pass 重放导致它被调用多次。为什么这里是安全的？

**参考答案**：`launch_once` 只是重复发射同一个 kernel，输入缓冲（Q/K/V、KV cache 页表）在闭包外构造一次后不再变化，重复发射幂等。多 pass 重放正是靠这个性质工作的：每个 pass 发射的工作必须相同，硬件计数器才能按指标分组分别累加。

**练习 3**：两个闭包的返回类型为什么是 `Result<(), String>` 而不是 `anyhow::Result<()>`？

**参考答案**：闭包要跨 FFI 边界被 C++ 侧回调（经 u2-l5/u3-l1 讲的蹦床）。蹦床把 `Ok(())` 转成 `0`、把 `Err` 转成 `1` 并把错误字符串暂存到 `CallbackState.error`，任何 Rust 错误类型都无法直接穿过 C ABI，所以消费端先用 `format!("{err:#}")` 把 anyhow 错误链压平成字符串。

### 4.2 prepare 闭包：`L2CacheClear` 与冷缓存测量

#### 4.2.1 概念说明

prepare 回调回答的问题是："**在开始计数之前，把测量环境整理成什么样？**"。对这个工具来说答案是：清空 L2 缓存。原因有二：

1. decode attention 的主要工作是读 KV cache。若上一轮测量的数据还留在 L2 里，kernel 会"免费"命中缓存，测出的带宽和时长都偏乐观，不代表生产环境（KV 读取接近流式，缓存里不会有现成数据）。
2. CUDA 官方的 `cudaCtxResetPersistingL2Cache` 系列接口只是把"持久化 L2 行"重置回普通状态，**不能驱逐普通缓存行**，所以只能用一个大数据量的流式 kernel 把 L2 里的旧数据"冲"出去。

#### 4.2.2 核心流程

```text
L2CacheClear::new(ctx):
  1. 查询设备 L2 大小（CU_DEVICE_ATTRIBUTE_L2_CACHE_SIZE）
  2. clear_bytes = max(2 × L2字节数, 128 MiB)     ← 两个常量：倍数 2、下限 128MiB
  3. len = clear_bytes / 2                          （bf16 每元素 2 字节）
  4. 分配三个长度为 len 的 bf16 缓冲：a、b、out

L2CacheClear::clear(ctx):                          （每次测量前调用）
  在设备流上发射 add_cuda(a, b, out, len)          ← 一次全量大数组加法，
                                                    读 a+b、写 out，各 clear_bytes 字节，
                                                    足以把 L2 旧内容全部替换掉
```

清多少字节才够？L2 容量为 \( C \)，清扫 kernel 的显存流量至少要 \( \geq C \) 才能把旧内容挤出去，代码取了 \( \max(2C,\ 128\,\text{MiB}) \) 留出裕量。

#### 4.2.3 源码精读

[pegainfer-qwen3/src/bin/report_support/common.rs:62-84](https://github.com/openinfer-project/openinfer/blob/8886aa47b95bc4beedb63584eb367276650b2fec/pegainfer-qwen3/src/bin/report_support/common.rs#L62-L84) 这段定义 `L2CacheClear` 结构并实现 `new`：查询 L2 大小，按 `cache_clear_bytes` 计算元素数，分配三个 bf16 缓冲（两个输入 + 一个输出）。

[pegainfer-qwen3/src/bin/report_support/common.rs:86-103](https://github.com/openinfer-project/openinfer/blob/8886aa47b95bc4beedb63584eb367276650b2fec/pegainfer-qwen3/src/bin/report_support/common.rs#L86-L103) 这段是 `clear` 本体：注释解释了为什么用流式 kernel 而不是 CUDA 的持久化 L2 重置 API；随后取三个缓冲的设备指针，调用 FFI 的 `add_cuda` 做一次全量向量加法，把 L2 旧内容冲掉。

[pegainfer-qwen3/src/bin/report_support/common.rs:25-26](https://github.com/openinfer-project/openinfer/blob/8886aa47b95bc4beedb63584eb367276650b2fec/pegainfer-qwen3/src/bin/report_support/common.rs#L25-L26) 这两行是清扫规模的常量：L2 大小的 2 倍、且不低于 128 MiB。

[pegainfer-qwen3/src/bin/report_support/common.rs:106-108](https://github.com/openinfer-project/openinfer/blob/8886aa47b95bc4beedb63584eb367276650b2fec/pegainfer-qwen3/src/bin/report_support/common.rs#L106-L108) 这个小函数把上面的规则封装成 `cache_clear_bytes(l2_bytes)`，报告 schema 里的 `cache_state: "l2_cleared_by_sweep"`（[qwen3_kernel_report.rs:938](https://github.com/openinfer-project/openinfer/blob/8886aa47b95bc4beedb63584eb367276650b2fec/pegainfer-qwen3/src/bin/qwen3_kernel_report.rs#L938)）描述的就是这套机制。

回看消费端：prepare 闭包只调 `cache_clear.clear(&clear_ctx)`（[qwen3_kernel_report.rs:1387-1391](https://github.com/openinfer-project/openinfer/blob/8886aa47b95bc4beedb63584eb367276650b2fec/pegainfer-qwen3/src/bin/qwen3_kernel_report.rs#L1387-L1391)）。CUPTI 侧会在**每个回放 pass、区间开始之前**执行它（时序细节在 u2-l3 精读），所以每一遍计数面对的都是冷缓存。另外注意 `clear_ctx` 是 `case.ctx` 的克隆——闭包需要的句柄要么 move 进去、要么克隆一份，不能借用局部变量。

#### 4.2.4 代码实践（计算 + 阅读）

1. **实践目标**：验证自己能算出清扫缓冲规模，并读懂 `clear` 里的设计取舍注释。
2. **操作步骤**：
   - 假设设备 A 的 L2 为 32 MiB、设备 B 的 L2 为 80 MiB，分别算 `cache_clear_bytes` 和 `len`（bf16 元素数）。
   - 阅读 [common.rs:86-103](https://github.com/openinfer-project/openinfer/blob/8886aa47b95bc4beedb63584eb367276650b2fec/pegainfer-qwen3/src/bin/report_support/common.rs#L86-L103) 的注释，用一句话复述"为什么不用 `cuCtxResetPersistingL2Cache`"。
3. **需要观察的现象**：设备 A 触发 128 MiB 下限，设备 B 触发 2 倍规则。
4. **预期结果**：A：\( \max(64\,\text{MiB}, 128\,\text{MiB}) = 128\,\text{MiB} \)，\( len = 128\,\text{MiB} / 2 = 67{,}108{,}864 \) 个 bf16；B：\( \max(160\,\text{MiB}, 128\,\text{MiB}) = 160\,\text{MiB} \)，\( len = 83{,}886{,}080 \)。注释复述要点：该 API 只重置"持久化"行，不驱逐普通缓存行，因此必须用清扫 kernel。

#### 4.2.5 小练习与答案

**练习 1**：如果去掉 `CACHE_CLEAR_MIN_BYTES` 下限，在一块 L2 只有 1 MiB 的小卡上会发生什么？

**参考答案**：清扫流量变成 2 MiB，虽然理论上是 L2 的两倍，但过小的单次访问可能不足以把 L2 中所有旧数据行都替换掉（缓存替换策略未必是严格 LRU 全覆盖），且清扫 kernel 本身的启动开销占比变大。128 MiB 下限保证了"冲刷"的确定性。

**练习 2**：prepare 回调在 `profile_range_with_prepare` 内部被执行的时机是在计数区间的内部还是外部？为什么这个位置很重要？

**参考答案**：外部——每个 pass 在 `cuptiRangeProfilerStart`、`PushRange` 之前执行 prepare（u2-l3 会精读这条时序）。如果清 L2 的清扫 kernel 落在区间内部，它自己的 DRAM/L2 流量和执行时间都会被计入计数器，测量结果就不再只属于被测 kernel。

### 4.3 `CUPTI_METRICS` 指标清单

#### 4.3.1 概念说明

`CUPTI_METRICS` 是一个 12 项的 `&[&str]` 常量，定义了每次采样要哪些硬件计数器换算出的指标。指标名遵循 `域__计数器.聚合.限定` 的命名法。这 12 个可以分成五组，覆盖"这个 kernel 慢在哪"的完整画像：

| 组 | 指标名 | 含义 |
|----|--------|------|
| 时间 | `gpu__time_duration.sum` | 区间内 GPU 工作总时长（文档示例按微秒记录，如 `4043.648us`） |
| 时间 | `sm__cycles_elapsed.avg.per_second` | SM 平均时钟频率（GHz），把周期数换算成时间的桥梁 |
| 显存流量 | `dram__bytes.sum` / `dram__bytes_op_read.sum` / `dram__bytes_op_write.sum` | DRAM 总流量 / 读流量 / 写流量（字节） |
| 缓存流量 | `lts__t_bytes.sum` | L2 cache（LTS 段）的总流量（字节） |
| 利用率 | `sm__throughput.avg.pct_of_peak_sustained_elapsed` | SM 吞吐占峰值百分比（SOL 类指标） |
| 利用率 | `smsp__warps_active.avg.pct_of_peak_sustained_active` | 活跃 warp 占比（occupancy 的直接读数） |
| tensor 管线 | `sm__pipe_tensor_cycles_active.avg.pct_of_peak_sustained_elapsed` | tensor 管线活跃周期占比 |
| tensor 管线 | `sm__pipe_tensor_subpipe_hmma_cycles_active.avg.pct_of_peak_sustained_elapsed` | 其中 HMMA 子管线的占比 |
| tensor 管线 | `sm__ops_path_tensor_op_hmma_src_bf16_dst_fp32_sparsity_off.sum.pct_of_peak_sustained_elapsed` | BF16→FP32、无稀疏 HMMA 操作数占峰值百分比——**可直接当 MFU 读** |
| tensor 管线 | 同上 `.sum.per_second` | 每秒完成的该类 HMMA 操作数（如 `211.727e12`） |

值得注意：时间/字节是**绝对量**，其余是**百分比**，可以互相印证——例如 DRAM 带宽 \( = \texttt{dram\_\_bytes.sum} / \texttt{gpu\_\_time\_duration.sum} \)，再对照峰值带宽就能手算"带宽利用率"，这正是 4.4 说的离线分析层要做的事。

#### 4.3.2 核心流程

指标列表的生命周期：

```text
常量定义 CUPTI_METRICS (12 项)
  ├─ 传入 profile_range_with_prepare → C++ 侧编译成 config image → 分组安排到 N 个 pass
  └─ 返回的 Vec<f64> 与列表按位置一一对应
       └─ cupti_metric_map zip 成 (指标名, 值) → 落盘 JSON
```

指标越多，pass 越多（硬件同时可用的计数器组有限）——这是 12 项指标换来更多回放次数的取舍。

#### 4.3.3 源码精读

[pegainfer-qwen3/src/bin/qwen3_kernel_report.rs:149-162](https://github.com/openinfer-project/openinfer/blob/8886aa47b95bc4beedb63584eb367276650b2fec/pegainfer-qwen3/src/bin/qwen3_kernel_report.rs#L149-L162) 这 14 行就是完整的指标清单，顺序即返回 `Vec<f64>` 的下标顺序。前 7 项是基础画像（时长、频率、DRAM/L2、SM/warp），后 5 项是 tensor 管线指标。

后 5 项是后来补的：[docs/subsystems/kernels/kernel-op-reports.md:207-214](https://github.com/openinfer-project/openinfer/blob/8886aa47b95bc4beedb63584eb367276650b2fec/docs/subsystems/kernels/kernel-op-reports.md#L207-L214) 记录了这次变更——作者先用 `ncu --query-metrics` 探查本机（RTX 5090）的指标目录，然后**把直接的 tensor 峰值百分比指标加进默认列表，而不是在运行器里算 MFU**。[kernel-op-reports.md:224](https://github.com/openinfer-project/openinfer/blob/8886aa47b95bc4beedb63584eb367276650b2fec/docs/subsystems/kernels/kernel-op-reports.md#L224) 给出结论：BF16-HMMA 峰值百分比指标本身就是答案，外部规格表推算的 MFU 只做 sanity check。这再次体现了"让硬件说硬件的话，解释留给离线层"的原则。

#### 4.3.4 代码实践（解读型）

1. **实践目标**：用文档里已存档的真实测量值做一次"读数训练"，学会从指标组合判断瓶颈。
2. **操作步骤**：阅读 [kernel-op-reports.md:180-184](https://github.com/openinfer-project/openinfer/blob/8886aa47b95bc4beedb63584eb367276650b2fec/docs/subsystems/kernels/kernel-op-reports.md#L180-L184) 中 `seq_len=10000` 时四个 prefill 阶段的 CUPTI 摘要，重点对比 `attn`（attention core）这一行。

4. **预期结果**：得出两个方向性结论—— 显存带宽不是瓶颈（L2 命中率极高，DRAM 流量很小）； 瓶颈是占用率太低（活跃 warp 只有 16%，tensor 管线喂不满）。这与 [kernel-op-reports.md:185](https://github.com/openinfer-project/openinfer/blob/8886aa47b95bc4beedb63584eb367276650b2fec/docs/subsystems/kernels/kernel-op-reports.md#L185) 的记录一致，后续 NCU 分析（[kernel-op-reports.md:233-241](https://github.com/openinfer-project/openinfer/blob/8886aa47b95bc4beedb63584eb367276650b2fec/docs/subsystems/kernels/kernel-op-reports.md#L233-L241)）把低占用的原因定位到寄存器和共享内存占用过高。

#### 4.3.5 小练习与答案

**练习 1**：`dram__bytes.sum` 与 `lts__t_bytes.sum` 分别在哪一级？为什么 attention core 的 L2 流量是 DRAM 的三十多倍反而是好事？

**参考答案**：`dram__*` 在显存（DRAM）级，`lts__*` 在 L2 cache 级。KV cache 在多轮迭代间被反复读，第二遍读取由 L2 命中，不必再下探 DRAM——L2 流量大说明数据复用发生在片上，显存带宽没有被浪费。真正要警惕的是反过来的情形：DRAM 流量逼近带宽上限。

**练习 2**：`smsp__warps_active...pct_of_peak_sustained_active` 测的是占用率，`sm__throughput...pct_of_peak_sustained_elapsed` 测的是吞吐。两者的差值（吞吐高、占用低）说明了什么？

**参考答案**：说明每个驻留 warp 都很"忙"（在持续发射指令），但驻留的 warp 数太少，硬件的多线程能力没用满。这正是 attention core 的处境：寄存器/共享内存限制让每块只能驻留很少 warp，tensor 管线只能靠这少数 warp 喂——优化方向是降低资源占用提升驻留数，而不是改访存。

**练习 3**：如果要给自己的 kernel 只选 3 个指标做快速体检，选哪三个？为什么？

**参考答案**：示例选法（合理即可）：`gpu__time_duration.sum`（时长基准）、`dram__bytes.sum`（算带宽是否到顶）、`smsp__warps_active.avg.pct_of_peak_sustained_active`（是否被占用率卡住）。三者分别覆盖时间、显存、执行资源三个维度，足够判断"慢在显存还是慢在执行"。

### 4.4 `cupti_metric_map` 与原始指标落盘约定

#### 4.4.1 概念说明

`profile_range_with_prepare` 返回的 `Vec<f64>` **不带名字**——第 i 个值对应 `CUPTI_METRICS[i]`，仅此而已。`cupti_metric_map` 负责把这层位置对应变成 `BTreeMap<String, f64>`，随后整个 map 原样写进报告 JSON 的 `case.cupti` 字段。

团队的硬约定是：**运行器不做任何解释**。早期版本曾有 `diagnosis` 字段、算好的 `dram_gb_s`/`dram_peak_pct` 等派生值，后来全部删掉（schema 升到 4）。理由：解释（带宽百分比、利用率标签、放大率门槛）依赖硬件与问题上下文，放进运行器会让 schema 反复变动、compare 逻辑被解释规则绑架；存原始值 + 离线解释则让同一份 JSON 可以被反复重新解读。

#### 4.4.2 核心流程

从 `Vec<f64>` 到 JSON 的完整数据流：

```text
profile_range_with_prepare → Vec<f64>（长度 = 12）
  ↓ cupti_metric_map：CUPTI_METRICS.iter().zip(values.iter()) → BTreeMap
CaseResult.cupti: Option<BTreeMap<String, f64>>
  ↓ cases 聚合进 KernelSnapshot
JSON: cases[].cupti = { "gpu__time_duration.sum": 4043.648, ... }
  ↓ 离线层（rank 子命令 / 人工 / 笔记本）按需推导带宽、SoL%、MFU
```

同时快照的 `measurement` 段记录测量条件（[qwen3_kernel_report.rs:936-950](https://github.com/openinfer-project/openinfer/blob/8886aa47b95bc4beedb63584eb367276650b2fec/pegainfer-qwen3/src/bin/qwen3_kernel_report.rs#L936-L950)）：`cupti_enabled`、开启时的 `cupti_metrics` 名单、`cache_state`、`iters` 等——让离线层知道"这份数据是在什么条件下采的"。

#### 4.4.3 源码精读

[pegainfer-qwen3/src/bin/qwen3_kernel_report.rs:1491-1498](https://github.com/openinfer-project/openinfer/blob/8886aa47b95bc4beedb63584eb367276650b2fec/pegainfer-qwen3/src/bin/qwen3_kernel_report.rs#L1491-L1498) 这六行就是 `cupti_metric_map` 的全部：按位置 zip 指标名和数值，收集成 `BTreeMap`（键有序，落盘 JSON 里指标按字典序排列，diff 友好）。四个 `measure_cupti_*` 的最后一行都是它。

[pegainfer-qwen3/src/bin/qwen3_kernel_report.rs:427-432](https://github.com/openinfer-project/openinfer/blob/8886aa47b95bc4beedb63584eb367276650b2fec/pegainfer-qwen3/src/bin/qwen3_kernel_report.rs#L427-L432) 这段是 `CaseResult` 的字段定义，`cupti: Option<BTreeMap<String, f64>>` 就是 JSON 里 `case.cupti` 的来源；`Option` 对应"本 case 没开 CUPTI 或采样失败"两种情况。

- [kernel-op-reports.md:114](https://github.com/openinfer-project/openinfer/blob/8886aa47b95bc4beedb63584eb367276650b2fec/docs/subsystems/kernels/kernel-op-reports.md#L114) ——写明"报告只存原始 CUPTI 指标名和数值，诊断标签、派生带宽百分比、读放大门槛都属于离线分析层"。
- [kernel-op-reports.md:130-134](https://github.com/openinfer-project/openinfer/blob/8886aa47b95bc4beedb63584eb367276650b2fec/docs/subsystems/kernels/kernel-op-reports.md#L130-L134) ——记录了删除 `diagnosis` 与派生字段、`compare` 只对 `latency_us` 设门槛的决策，schema 因此升到 4。
- [kernel-op-reports.md:469](https://github.com/openinfer-project/openinfer/blob/8886aa47b95bc4beedb63584eb367276650b2fec/docs/subsystems/kernels/kernel-op-reports.md#L469) ——教训总结："指标解释不进运行器；JSON 存原始 CUPTI 值，带宽/利用率/IO 模型检查放在独立的报告或笔记本层"。

#### 4.4.4 代码实践（离线分析演练）

1. **实践目标**：亲手扮演一次"离线解释层"，体会运行器/解释层分层的价值。
2. **操作步骤**：取 [kernel-op-reports.md:181](https://github.com/openinfer-project/openinfer/blob/8886aa47b95bc4beedb63584eb367276650b2fec/docs/subsystems/kernels/kernel-op-reports.md#L181) 中 QK+RoPE 阶段的数据（`gpu__time_duration.sum=285.664us`、`DRAM 203.183MB`），计算带宽（示例代码）：

   ```python
   # 示例代码：离线推导，不属于项目源码
   dram_bytes = 203.183e6
   duration_s = 285.664e-6
   gb_per_s = dram_bytes / duration_s / 1e9
   print(f"{gb_per_s:.1f} GB/s")   # 再除以设备峰值带宽即得占用百分比
   ```

3. **需要观察的现象**：算出的带宽值与文档记录的 `SM throughput 51.880%` 是两个独立维度——前者看显存，后者看执行单元。
4. **预期结果**：约 711 GB/s。注意这个数字若接近设备峰值，说明 QK+RoPE 受显存限制；若远低于峰值而 SM 吞吐也不高，则两头都没吃满，需要再看占用率指标。
5. 文档数值为已存档的 GPU 测量结果，本机复算只需手算/脚本，无需 GPU；**若要重新采样得到本机数值，待本地验证**。

#### 4.4.5 小练习与答案

**练习 1**：为什么 `cupti_metric_map` 用 `BTreeMap` 而不是 `HashMap`？

**参考答案**：`BTreeMap` 按键有序，序列化成 JSON 后指标顺序稳定，两次运行的结果可以直接做文本 diff 或机器对比；`HashMap` 顺序不定，会让报告噪音变大。

**练习 2**：`compare` 子命令为什么只对 `latency_us` 设回归门槛，而不对 CUPTI 指标设门槛？

**参考答案**：见 [kernel-op-reports.md:133](https://github.com/openinfer-project/openinfer/blob/8886aa47b95bc4beedb63584eb367276650b2fec/docs/subsystems/kernels/kernel-op-reports.md#L133)。计数器指标受时钟、驱动、温度等影响波动较大，且不同 GPU 的"正常值"完全不同；把解释性门槛放进 compare 会让回归门槛随硬件漂移。延迟是最终关心的量，门槛只看它；计数器留给离线诊断。

**练习 3**：`case.cupti` 是 `Option`。哪两种情况下它会是 `None`/缺失？

**参考答案**： 运行时传了 `--no-cupti`（`args.cupti == false`，四个 `measure_*_case` 里的 `if args.cupti` 分支不执行）； 采样过程中出错——错误会被写进 `case.error`，`cupti` 保持初始的 `None`。

## 5. 综合实践

**任务**：跑两次最小报告（开/关 CUPTI），对比 JSON，亲眼看到 `case.cupti` 的出现与消失——这是把本讲四个模块串起来的闭环。

### 有 GPU 与 CUDA 工具链的环境

1. **实践目标**：确认 `--no-cupti` 只影响 `cupti` 相关字段，其他测量（latency、measurement 元数据）照常工作。

2. **操作步骤**：

   ```bash
   # 第一次：显式关闭 CUPTI（本命令与 docs/subsystems/kernels/kernel-op-reports.md
   # 的 GPU 验证记录一致）
   cargo run --release -p pegainfer-qwen3 --features kernel-report \
     --bin qwen3_kernel_report -- run --no-cupti --iters 1 \
     --contexts 1024 --batch-sizes 1 --variants non_partition \
     --out /tmp/report_nocupti.json

   # 第二次：去掉 --no-cupti（CUPTI 默认开启）
   cargo run --release -p pegainfer-qwen3 --features kernel-report \
     --bin qwen3_kernel_report -- run --iters 1 \
     --contexts 1024 --batch-sizes 1 --variants non_partition \
     --out /tmp/report_cupti.json
   ```

   提示：若 `nvidia-smi` 不可用，按项目惯例加 `PEGAINFER_CUDA_SM=<架构号>`（如 `120`）环境变量。构建需要编译 CUDA 源，首次耗时较长，务必用 `--release`。

3. **需要观察的现象**（用编辑器或 `jq` 打开两份 JSON 对比）：
   - `measurement.cupti_enabled`：`false` vs `true`；
   - `measurement.cupti_metrics`：空数组 vs 12 个指标名的列表；
   - `cases[0].cupti`：缺失（`null`）vs 一个含 12 个键的 map，键名与 `CUPTI_METRICS` 完全一致、按键有序；
   - `cases[0].latency_us` 两份都有值（关闭 CUPTI 不影响延迟测量）；
   - `schema` 字段两份都是 `4`。

4. **预期结果**：两份 JSON 除上述 cupti 相关差异外结构一致；开启 CUPTI 的那次运行时间明显更长（每个 case 要建 CUPTI 会话并多 pass 回放）。上述现象的具体数值**待本地验证**。

### 没有 GPU 的环境（替代实践）

1. **实践目标**：不运行也能掌握调用模板与 range 命名规则。
2. **操作步骤**：在 `pegainfer-qwen3/src/bin/qwen3_kernel_report.rs` 中定位 L1079（`measure_cupti_dense`）、L1368（`measure_cupti_decode`）、L1407（`measure_cupti_prefill`）三处 `profile_range_with_prepare` 调用，为每处的 `range_name` 写一行注释，说明前缀（`qd/`、`qk/`、`qpf/`）和各段的来源（op 名/路径名/阶段-变体/形状参数）。
3. **需要观察的现象**：三处调用的参数结构完全相同，只有 case 类型、range 名和闭包内容不同。
4. **预期结果**：例如 `--variants non_partition --contexts 1024 --batch-sizes 1` 对应 range 名 `qk/non_partition/b1/k1024`；prefill attention core 的 `cta_q64` 变体在 `s=10000` 时对应 `qpf/attn-q64/b1/s10000`。

## 6. 本讲小结

- 消费端调用模板五要素：**context、device_index、range 名、指标列表、prepare/launch 闭包**；四个 `measure_cupti_*` 函数共享这一模板，差异只在 case 类型、range 前缀和闭包内容。
- **prepare 负责整理环境，launch 负责发射被测 kernel**：prepare 用 `L2CacheClear`（`max(2×L2, 128MiB)` 字节的流式加法）在每个 pass 的计数区间外清空 L2，保证冷缓存测量；launch 的 kernel 必须可重复发射，因为多 pass 回放会多次调用它。
- `CUPTI_METRICS` 的 12 个指标分五组：时长/频率、DRAM 流量、L2 流量、SM/warp 利用率、tensor 管线（含可直接当 MFU 读的 BF16-HMMA 峰值百分比）。
- **运行器只存原始指标**：`cupti_metric_map` 把按位置对应的 `Vec<f64>` 变成 `BTreeMap` 落盘到 `case.cupti`；带宽、利用率、诊断标签一律留在离线层，`compare` 只对延迟设门槛（schema 4）。
- 采样入口之外的两条工程护栏同样关键：预热发射挡住惰性初始化污染；`--no-cupti` 让没有 CUPTI 工具链的环境仍能跑延迟测量（CUPTI 默认开启）。

## 7. 下一步学习建议

本讲看的是"怎么用"，下一单元（u2）开始拆"怎么实现"。建议顺序：

1. **u2-l1（C ABI 契约）**：跳到 [pegainfer-cupti/csrc/range_profiler.cpp](https://github.com/openinfer-project/openinfer/blob/8886aa47b95bc4beedb63584eb367276650b2fec/pegainfer-cupti/csrc/range_profiler.cpp)，对照本讲的调用模板，看这五个要素在 C++ 侧如何变成 12 个裸参数，以及入口处的防御性校验。
2. **u2-l3（回放循环）**：验证本讲反复引用的事实——prepare 确实在 `Start`/`PushRange` 之前、每个 pass 执行一次；理解 `launch_once` 为何会被调用多次。
3. 顺带重读本讲的两个文档锚点：[kernel-op-reports.md](https://github.com/openinfer-project/openinfer/blob/8886aa47b95bc4beedb63584eb367276650b2fec/docs/subsystems/kernels/kernel-op-reports.md) 的 Step 10（为什么删派生字段）与 Step 14（为什么加 tensor 指标）——它们是这个工具最重要的两条设计决策记录。

# 从消费者看效果：qwen3_kernel_report 如何用一次 profile 调用拿到硬件计数器

## 1. 本讲目标

学完本讲，你应该能够：

1. 默写 `profile_range_with_prepare` 的调用模板——五个要素：context、device_index、range 名、指标列表、prepare/launch 两个闭包。
2. 解释 prepare 与 launch 两个回调的分工：prepare 在计数区间开始前清空 L2 缓存（冷缓存测量），launch 发射被测 kernel 并可被安全地重复执行。
3. 读懂 `CUPTI_METRICS` 里 12 个指标名的含义（时长、DRAM/L2 流量、SM 吞吐占比、tensor 管线占比等）。
4. 说清团队约定：**运行器只落盘原始指标名和数值，一切解释（带宽、利用率、MFU）放到离线分析层**。

## 2. 前置知识

前两讲（u1-l1、u1-l2）已经建立了这些认知，这里直接承接、不再展开：

- `pegainfer-cupti` 是 Rust 通向 NVIDIA CUPTI Range Profiler 的桥，唯一公开函数是 `profile_range_with_prepare`；指标较多时 CUPTI 会**多遍回放**（replay）被测区间，所以 launch 闭包必须可以安全重复执行。
- 这个 crate 只有四个文件，CUPTI 通过 `kernel-report` feature + optional 依赖 + `required-features` 三层门控挡在默认构建图之外。

本讲新增的几个术语：

| 术语 | 通俗解释 |
|------|----------|
| decode attention（解码注意力） | 推理时逐 token 生成阶段执行的注意力 kernel，每次只算一个新 token 对全部历史 KV 的注意力 |
| 冷缓存（cold L2） | 测量前把 GPU 的 L2 缓存清空，让 kernel 面对的是"第一次读到数据"的状态。Qwen3 的 decode attention 主要在读 KV cache，生产环境中这些读取接近流式，冷缓存才是有代表性的测量条件 |
| 硬件计数器指标名 | CUPTI 的指标名形如 `域__计数器.聚合方式.限定词`，例如 `dram__bytes.sum` = DRAM 域的 bytes 计数器取求和；`sm__throughput.avg.pct_of_peak_sustained_elapsed` = SM 吞吐取平均、以峰值百分比表达 |
| 区间（range） | Range Profiler 的测量单位：一段被命名的 GPU 工作集合，计数器只统计落在这个区间里的 kernel |

## 3. 本讲源码地图

| 文件 | 作用 |
|------|------|
| [pegainfer-qwen3/src/bin/qwen3_kernel_report.rs](https://github.com/openinfer-project/openinfer/blob/8886aa47b95bc4beedb63584eb367276650b2fec/pegainfer-qwen3/src/bin/qwen3_kernel_report.rs) | 消费方：manifest 驱动的 per-op kernel 报告运行器，本讲的主角。含 `CUPTI_METRICS`、四个 `measure_cupti_*` 函数和 `cupti_metric_map` |
| [pegainfer-qwen3/src/bin/report_support/common.rs](https://github.com/openinfer-project/openinfer/blob/8886aa47b95bc4beedb63584eb367276650b2fec/pegainfer-qwen3/src/bin/report_support/common.rs) | 报告工具共享原语：设备常量、`L2CacheClear`（L2 清扫）、带宽查询 |
| [pegainfer-qwen3/src/bin/report_support/decode_attention.rs](https://github.com/openinfer-project/openinfer/blob/8886aa47b95bc4beedb63584eb367276650b2fec/pegainfer-qwen3/src/bin/report_support/decode_attention.rs) | decode attention 测量 case 定义；`DecodePath::name` 决定 range 名里的变体段 |
| [pegainfer-cupti/src/lib.rs](https://github.com/openinfer-project/openinfer/blob/8886aa47b95bc4beedb63584eb367276650b2fec/pegainfer-cupti/src/lib.rs) | 被消费方：把 12 个 C ABI 裸参数收敛成一个带闭包的 unsafe 函数 |

## 4. 核心概念与源码讲解

### 4.1 调用模板：`measure_cupti_decode` 的五个要素

#### 4.1.1 概念说明

`profile_range_with_prepare` 是个 `unsafe` 函数，签名在 [pegainfer-cupti/src/lib.rs:79-92](https://github.com/openinfer-project/openinfer/blob/8886aa47b95bc4beedb63584eb367276650b2fec/pegainfer-cupti/src/lib.rs#L79-L92)：文档注释写明安全契约——`context` 必须是对应 `device_index` 上活着的 CUDA `CUcontext`，且回调只能在该 context 上发射工作。函数本体我们已经知道：闭包经蹦床回传、输出缓冲变 `Vec<f64>` 返回值、错误合并成 `CuptiProfilerError`。

站在**消费者**的角度，每次调用只需要凑齐五个要素：

1. **context**：裸的 `CUcontext` 指针（`case.cu_context_ptr()`）；
2. **device_index**：设备序号（`case.ctx.device_ordinal`）；
3. **range 名**：一个人类可读字符串，标识这段被测区间；
4. **指标列表**：`CUPTI_METRICS`，本讲 4.3 展开；
5. **prepare / launch 两个闭包**：都返回 `Result<(), String>`，错误用字符串回传。

#### 4.1.2 核心流程

以 `measure_cupti_decode` 为例，从函数入口到拿到 `BTreeMap<String, f64>` 共八步：

```text
1. AttentionDecodeCase::for_spec(spec)     分配 case（KV cache、Q/K/V 缓冲等合成数据）
2. case.launch_once(path) + sync           预热一次：让 CUDA/FlashInfer 的惰性初始化
                                           发生在计数区间之外
3. L2CacheClear::new(&case.ctx)            准备 L2 清扫器（4.2 展开）
4. 取出三个"逃生"变量：
     context       = case.cu_context_ptr()          （裸指针，第 1 要素）
     device_ordinal = case.ctx.device_ordinal       （第 2 要素）
     clear_ctx     = case.ctx.clone()               （给 prepare 闭包用）
5. range_name = "qk/{path名}/b{batch}/k{kv_len}"    （第 3 要素）
6. prepare 闭包 = 清 L2；launch 闭包 = 再发射一次被测 kernel（第 5 要素）
7. unsafe { profile_range_with_prepare(context, device_ordinal, &range_name,
                                       CUPTI_METRICS, Some(&mut prepare), &mut launch) }
8. Ok(cupti_metric_map(&values))           Vec<f64> → BTreeMap<指标名, 值>（4.4 展开）
```

注意第 6 步的 launch 闭包与第 2 步的预热是**同一个动作**（`launch_once`）——预热在区间外执行一次，回放循环里每次 pass 再执行一次。这正是 u1-l1 说的"launch 闭包必须可重复安全执行"在消费端的实现方式：`launch_once` 不改变输入缓冲，重复发射结果一致。

#### 4.1.3 源码精读

入口与预热——先构造 case、发射一次并同步，把惰性初始化挡在测量之外：

[pegainfer-qwen3/src/bin/qwen3_kernel_report.rs:1372-1374](https://github.com/openinfer-project/openinfer/blob/8886aa47b95bc4beedb63584eb367276650b2fec/pegainfer-qwen3/src/bin/qwen3_kernel_report.rs#L1372-L1374) 这三行构造 decode case、预发射一次 kernel 并同步，确保后续 CUPTI 计数不被 CUDA/FlashInfer 的惰性初始化污染。

[pegainfer-qwen3/src/bin/qwen3_kernel_report.rs:1376-1385](https://github.com/openinfer-project/openinfer/blob/8886aa47b95bc4beedb63584eb367276650b2fec/pegainfer-qwen3/src/bin/qwen3_kernel_report.rs#L1376-L1385) 这段准备 L2 清扫器，取出 context、device_ordinal、克隆一份 clear_ctx，并把 range 名拼成 `qk/{变体名}/b{batch}/k{kv_len}` 的格式。

[pegainfer-qwen3/src/bin/qwen3_kernel_report.rs:1387-1392](https://github.com/openinfer-project/openinfer/blob/8886aa47b95bc4beedb63584eb367276650b2fec/pegainfer-qwen3/src/bin/qwen3_kernel_report.rs#L1387-L1392) 这两个闭包就是模板的第 5 要素：`prepare` 只做一件事——清 L2；`launch` 调 `case.launch_once(path)` 发射被测 kernel。两者都把 `anyhow::Error` 链压平成 `String`（`format!("{err:#}")`），因为跨 FFI 只能传字符串。

[pegainfer-qwen3/src/bin/qwen3_kernel_report.rs:1393-1402](https://github.com/openinfer-project/openinfer/blob/8886aa47b95bc4beedb63584eb367276650b2fec/pegainfer-qwen3/src/bin/qwen3_kernel_report.rs#L1393-L1402) 这是 `unsafe` 调用点本体：五个要素按顺序传入，返回的 `Vec<f64>` 与 `CUPTI_METRICS` 等长（pegainfer-cupti 侧预分配了同样长度的输出缓冲）。

range 名里的变体段来自 [pegainfer-qwen3/src/bin/report_support/decode_attention.rs:76-80](https://github.com/openinfer-project/openinfer/blob/8886aa47b95bc4beedb63584eb367276650b2fec/pegainfer-qwen3/src/bin/report_support/decode_attention.rs#L76-L80) ——这段代码把 `DecodePath` 映射成 `non_partition` 或 split-KV 配置的 label，所以本讲实践命令里的 `--variants non_partition` 对应的 range 名就是 `qk/non_partition/b1/k1024`。

同样的模板在文件里还有三份拷贝，只是 case 类型和 range 前缀不同：

| `measure_cupti_decode` | [qwen3_kernel_report.rs:1368-1405](https://github.com/openinfer-project/openinfer/blob/8886aa47b95bc4beedb63584eb367276650b2fec/pegainfer-qwen3/src/bin/qwen3_kernel_report.rs#L1368-L1405) | `qk/{路径名}/b{batch}/k{kv长度}` | 直接 move 进 launch 闭包 |

1. **实践目标**：确认四个 `measure_cupti_*` 函数共享同一模板，并理解 case 持有方式的差异。
2. **操作步骤**：打开 `pegainfer-qwen3/src/bin/qwen3_kernel_report.rs`，依次跳到 L1079、L1368、L1407、L1453，给每个函数的三处加行内注释：`(a) 预热发射`、`(b) range 名`、`(c) profile 调用`。

4. **预期结果**：decode 的 prepare 闭包完全不碰 `case`（只碰 `cache_clear`），所以 case 可以整个交给 launch；prefill 的 prepare 要调 `prepare_stage`、launch 要调 `launch_stage`，两者都要可变借用，只能用 `RefCell` 在两个闭包间共享。

#### 4.1.5 小练习与答案

**练习 1**：为什么 `measure_cupti_decode` 在构造闭包之前要先 `case.launch_once(path)?; case.ctx.sync()?;`（L1373-1374）？

**参考答案**：这是预热发射。CUDA 驱动和 FlashInfer kernel 都有惰性初始化（模块加载、句柄创建等），这些开销一旦落进测量区间就会污染计数器。先在区间外发射一次并同步，回放循环里每次 pass 计到的就只有 kernel 本体。这与报告 schema 里记录的 `pre_measure_launches: 1`（[qwen3_kernel_report.rs:939](https://github.com/openinfer-project/openinfer/blob/8886aa47b95bc4beedb63584eb367276650b2fec/pegainfer-qwen3/src/bin/qwen3_kernel_report.rs#L939)）对应。

**练习 2**：launch 闭包捕获了 `case`，而 CUPTI 可能多 pass 重放导致它被调用多次。为什么这里是安全的？

**参考答案**：`launch_once` 只是重复发射同一个 kernel，输入缓冲（Q/K/V、KV cache 页表）在闭包外构造一次后不再变化，重复发射幂等。多 pass 重放正是靠这个性质工作的：每个 pass 发射的工作必须相同，硬件计数器才能按指标分组分别累加。

**练习 3**：两个闭包的返回类型为什么是 `Result<(), String>` 而不是 `anyhow::Result<()>`？

**参考答案**：闭包要跨 FFI 边界被 C++ 侧回调（经 u2-l5/u3-l1 讲的蹦床）。蹦床把 `Ok(())` 转成 `0`、把 `Err` 转成 `1` 并把错误字符串暂存到 `CallbackState.error`，任何 Rust 错误类型都无法直接穿过 C ABI，所以消费端先用 `format!("{err:#}")` 把 anyhow 错误链压平成字符串。

### 4.2 prepare 闭包：`L2CacheClear` 与冷缓存测量

#### 4.2.1 概念说明

prepare 回调回答的问题是："**在开始计数之前，把测量环境整理成什么样？**"。对这个工具来说答案是：清空 L2 缓存。原因有二：

1. decode attention 的主要工作是读 KV cache。若上一轮测量的数据还留在 L2 里，kernel 会"免费"命中缓存，测出的带宽和时长都偏乐观，不代表生产环境（KV 读取接近流式，缓存里不会有现成数据）。
2. CUDA 官方的 `cudaCtxResetPersistingL2Cache` 系列接口只是把"持久化 L2 行"重置回普通状态，**不能驱逐普通缓存行**，所以只能用一个大数据量的流式 kernel 把 L2 里的旧数据"冲"出去。

#### 4.2.2 核心流程

```text
L2CacheClear::new(ctx):
  1. 查询设备 L2 大小（CU_DEVICE_ATTRIBUTE_L2_CACHE_SIZE）
  2. clear_bytes = max(2 × L2字节数, 128 MiB)     ← 两个常量：倍数 2、下限 128MiB
  3. len = clear_bytes / 2                          （bf16 每元素 2 字节）
  4. 分配三个长度为 len 的 bf16 缓冲：a、b、out

L2CacheClear::clear(ctx):                          （每次测量前调用）
  在设备流上发射 add_cuda(a, b, out, len)          ← 一次全量大数组加法，
                                                    读 a+b、写 out，各 clear_bytes 字节，
                                                    足以把 L2 旧内容全部替换掉
```

清多少字节才够？L2 容量为 \( C \)，清扫 kernel 的显存流量至少要 \( \geq C \) 才能把旧内容挤出去，代码取了 \( \max(2C,\ 128\,\text{MiB}) \) 留出裕量。

#### 4.2.3 源码精读

[pegainfer-qwen3/src/bin/report_support/common.rs:62-84](https://github.com/openinfer-project/openinfer/blob/8886aa47b95bc4beedb63584eb367276650b2fec/pegainfer-qwen3/src/bin/report_support/common.rs#L62-L84) 这段定义 `L2CacheClear` 结构并实现 `new`：查询 L2 大小，按 `cache_clear_bytes` 计算元素数，分配三个 bf16 缓冲（两个输入 + 一个输出）。

[pegainfer-qwen3/src/bin/report_support/common.rs:86-103](https://github.com/openinfer-project/openinfer/blob/8886aa47b95bc4beedb63584eb367276650b2fec/pegainfer-qwen3/src/bin/report_support/common.rs#L86-L103) 这段是 `clear` 本体：注释解释了为什么用流式 kernel 而不是 CUDA 的持久化 L2 重置 API；随后取三个缓冲的设备指针，调用 FFI 的 `add_cuda` 做一次全量向量加法，把 L2 旧内容冲掉。

[pegainfer-qwen3/src/bin/report_support/common.rs:25-26](https://github.com/openinfer-project/openinfer/blob/8886aa47b95bc4beedb63584eb367276650b2fec/pegainfer-qwen3/src/bin/report_support/common.rs#L25-L26) 这两行是清扫规模的常量：L2 大小的 2 倍、且不低于 128 MiB。

[pegainfer-qwen3/src/bin/report_support/common.rs:106-108](https://github.com/openinfer-project/openinfer/blob/8886aa47b95bc4beedb63584eb367276650b2fec/pegainfer-qwen3/src/bin/report_support/common.rs#L106-L108) 这个小函数把上面的规则封装成 `cache_clear_bytes(l2_bytes)`，报告 schema 里的 `cache_state: "l2_cleared_by_sweep"`（[qwen3_kernel_report.rs:938](https://github.com/openinfer-project/openinfer/blob/8886aa47b95bc4beedb63584eb367276650b2fec/pegainfer-qwen3/src/bin/qwen3_kernel_report.rs#L938)）描述的就是这套机制。

回看消费端：prepare 闭包只调 `cache_clear.clear(&clear_ctx)`（[qwen3_kernel_report.rs:1387-1391](https://github.com/openinfer-project/openinfer/blob/8886aa47b95bc4beedb63584eb367276650b2fec/pegainfer-qwen3/src/bin/qwen3_kernel_report.rs#L1387-L1391)）。CUPTI 侧会在**每个回放 pass、区间开始之前**执行它（时序细节在 u2-l3 精读），所以每一遍计数面对的都是冷缓存。另外注意 `clear_ctx` 是 `case.ctx` 的克隆——闭包需要的句柄要么 move 进去、要么克隆一份，不能借用局部变量。

#### 4.2.4 代码实践（计算 + 阅读）

1. **实践目标**：验证自己能算出清扫缓冲规模，并读懂 `clear` 里的设计取舍注释。
2. **操作步骤**：
   - 假设设备 A 的 L2 为 32 MiB、设备 B 的 L2 为 80 MiB，分别算 `cache_clear_bytes` 和 `len`（bf16 元素数）。
   - 阅读 [common.rs:86-103](https://github.com/openinfer-project/openinfer/blob/8886aa47b95bc4beedb63584eb367276650b2fec/pegainfer-qwen3/src/bin/report_support/common.rs#L86-L103) 的注释，用一句话复述"为什么不用 `cuCtxResetPersistingL2Cache`"。
3. **需要观察的现象**：设备 A 触发 128 MiB 下限，设备 B 触发 2 倍规则。
4. **预期结果**：A：\( \max(64\,\text{MiB}, 128\,\text{MiB}) = 128\,\text{MiB} \)，\( len = 128\,\text{MiB} / 2 = 67{,}108{,}864 \) 个 bf16；B：\( \max(160\,\text{MiB}, 128\,\text{MiB}) = 160\,\text{MiB} \)，\( len = 83{,}886{,}080 \)。注释复述要点：该 API 只重置"持久化"行，不驱逐普通缓存行，因此必须用清扫 kernel。

#### 4.2.5 小练习与答案

**练习 1**：如果去掉 `CACHE_CLEAR_MIN_BYTES` 下限，在一块 L2 只有 1 MiB 的小卡上会发生什么？

**参考答案**：清扫流量变成 2 MiB，虽然理论上是 L2 的两倍，但过小的单次访问可能不足以把 L2 中所有旧数据行都替换掉（缓存替换策略未必是严格 LRU 全覆盖），且清扫 kernel 本身的启动开销占比变大。128 MiB 下限保证了"冲刷"的确定性。

**练习 2**：prepare 回调在 `profile_range_with_prepare` 内部被执行的时机是在计数区间的内部还是外部？为什么这个位置很重要？

**参考答案**：外部——每个 pass 在 `cuptiRangeProfilerStart`、`PushRange` 之前执行 prepare（u2-l3 会精读这条时序）。如果清 L2 的清扫 kernel 落在区间内部，它自己的 DRAM/L2 流量和执行时间都会被计入计数器，测量结果就不再只属于被测 kernel。

### 4.3 `CUPTI_METRICS` 指标清单

#### 4.3.1 概念说明

`CUPTI_METRICS` 是一个 12 项的 `&[&str]` 常量，定义了每次采样要哪些硬件计数器换算出的指标。指标名遵循 `域__计数器.聚合.限定` 的命名法。这 12 个可以分成五组，覆盖"这个 kernel 慢在哪"的完整画像：

| 组 | 指标名 | 含义 |
|----|--------|------|
| 时间 | `gpu__time_duration.sum` | 区间内 GPU 工作总时长（文档示例按微秒记录，如 `4043.648us`） |
| 时间 | `sm__cycles_elapsed.avg.per_second` | SM 平均时钟频率（GHz），把周期数换算成时间的桥梁 |
| 显存流量 | `dram__bytes.sum` / `dram__bytes_op_read.sum` / `dram__bytes_op_write.sum` | DRAM 总流量 / 读流量 / 写流量（字节） |
| 缓存流量 | `lts__t_bytes.sum` | L2 cache（LTS 段）的总流量（字节） |
| 利用率 | `sm__throughput.avg.pct_of_peak_sustained_elapsed` | SM 吞吐占峰值百分比（SOL 类指标） |
| 利用率 | `smsp__warps_active.avg.pct_of_peak_sustained_active` | 活跃 warp 占比（occupancy 的直接读数） |
| tensor 管线 | `sm__pipe_tensor_cycles_active.avg.pct_of_peak_sustained_elapsed` | tensor 管线活跃周期占比 |
| tensor 管线 | `sm__pipe_tensor_subpipe_hmma_cycles_active.avg.pct_of_peak_sustained_elapsed` | 其中 HMMA 子管线的占比 |
| tensor 管线 | `sm__ops_path_tensor_op_hmma_src_bf16_dst_fp32_sparsity_off.sum.pct_of_peak_sustained_elapsed` | BF16→FP32、无稀疏 HMMA 操作数占峰值百分比——**可直接当 MFU 读** |
| tensor 管线 | 同上 `.sum.per_second` | 每秒完成的该类 HMMA 操作数（如 `211.727e12`） |

值得注意：时间/字节是**绝对量**，其余是**百分比**，可以互相印证——例如 DRAM 带宽 \( = \texttt{dram\_\_bytes.sum} / \texttt{gpu\_\_time\_duration.sum} \)，再对照峰值带宽就能手算"带宽利用率"，这正是 4.4 说的离线分析层要做的事。

#### 4.3.2 核心流程

指标列表的生命周期：

```text
常量定义 CUPTI_METRICS (12 项)
  ├─ 传入 profile_range_with_prepare → C++ 侧编译成 config image → 分组安排到 N 个 pass
  └─ 返回的 Vec<f64> 与列表按位置一一对应
       └─ cupti_metric_map zip 成 (指标名, 值) → 落盘 JSON
```

指标越多，pass 越多（硬件同时可用的计数器组有限）——这是 12 项指标换来更多回放次数的取舍。

#### 4.3.3 源码精读

[pegainfer-qwen3/src/bin/qwen3_kernel_report.rs:149-162](https://github.com/openinfer-project/openinfer/blob/8886aa47b95bc4beedb63584eb367276650b2fec/pegainfer-qwen3/src/bin/qwen3_kernel_report.rs#L149-L162) 这 14 行就是完整的指标清单，顺序即返回 `Vec<f64>` 的下标顺序。前 7 项是基础画像（时长、频率、DRAM/L2、SM/warp），后 5 项是 tensor 管线指标。

后 5 项是后来补的：[docs/subsystems/kernels/kernel-op-reports.md:207-214](https://github.com/openinfer-project/openinfer/blob/8886aa47b95bc4beedb63584eb367276650b2fec/docs/subsystems/kernels/kernel-op-reports.md#L207-L214) 记录了这次变更——作者先用 `ncu --query-metrics` 探查本机（RTX 5090）的指标目录，然后**把直接的 tensor 峰值百分比指标加进默认列表，而不是在运行器里算 MFU**。[kernel-op-reports.md:224](https://github.com/openinfer-project/openinfer/blob/8886aa47b95bc4beedb63584eb367276650b2fec/docs/subsystems/kernels/kernel-op-reports.md#L224) 给出结论：BF16-HMMA 峰值百分比指标本身就是答案，外部规格表推算的 MFU 只做 sanity check。这再次体现了"让硬件说硬件的话，解释留给离线层"的原则。

#### 4.3.4 代码实践（解读型）

1. **实践目标**：用文档里已存档的真实测量值做一次"读数训练"，学会从指标组合判断瓶颈。
2. **操作步骤**：阅读 [kernel-op-reports.md:180-184](https://github.com/openinfer-project/openinfer/blob/8886aa47b95bc4beedb63584eb367276650b2fec/docs/subsystems/kernels/kernel-op-reports.md#L180-L184) 中 `seq_len=10000` 时四个 prefill 阶段的 CUPTI 摘要，重点对比 `attn`（attention core）这一行。
3. **需要观察的现象**：attention core 行里 `L2 6650MB` 远大于 `DRAM 205MB`；`active warps 16.020%` 远低于 `SM throughput 41.410%`。
4. **预期结果**：得出两个方向性结论—— 显存带宽不是瓶颈（L2 命中率极高，DRAM 流量很小）； 瓶颈是占用率太低（活跃 warp 只有 16%，tensor 管线喂不满）。这与 [kernel-op-reports.md:185](https://github.com/openinfer-project/openinfer/blob/8886aa47b95bc4beedb63584eb367276650b2fec/docs/subsystems/kernels/kernel-op-reports.md#L185) 的记录一致，后续 NCU 分析（[kernel-op-reports.md:233-241](https://github.com/openinfer-project/openinfer/blob/8886aa47b95bc4beedb63584eb367276650b2fec/docs/subsystems/kernels/kernel-op-reports.md#L233-L241)）把低占用的原因定位到寄存器和共享内存占用过高。
